##  Error Resolution - Linking Aadhaar with PAN
19-Jul-2023
Seo description
NA
Video thumbnail

Video embed
<https://youtu.be/MwqJMFSLPH0>[(link is external)](https://youtu.be/MwqJMFSLPH0)
Video description
This video is on resolution of errors while Linking Aadhaar with PAN. The links for correction your PAN details are [https://www.onlineservices.nsdl.com(link is external)](https://www.onlineservices.nsdl.com/paam/endUserRegisterContact.html), or [https://www.pan.utiitsl.com(link is external)](https://www.pan.utiitsl.com/PAN/mainform.html;jsessionid=B3A9443C26F9755063EFD5A7B32B2E11)
The link for correction of Aadhaar details on [UIDAI](https://uidai.gov.in/en/my-aadhaar/update-aadhaar.html) website (<https://uidai.gov.in/my-aadhaar/update-aadhaar.html>).
